'''Skrisst''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] who served in the [[Trandoshan pirates|Trandoshan Pirates]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. He assisted [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Krussk (pirate)|Krussk]] with his takeover of [[Bunker Krill]], which was controlled by the [[Umbaran militia]] and their [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] allies. [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|A Jedi Knight]] infiltrated the bunker, destroying all enemies in their path, and defeating Krussk, [[Mrash]] and Skrisst.
